description_en: Queries the list of created image repair tasks
description_zh: 查询已创建的镜像修复任务的列表
name: DescribeImageFixTask

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的修复任务开始的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的修复任务结束的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the image repair task that you want to query. Valid values:

1: Repairing
2: Repaired
3: Repair failed
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的镜像修复任务的状态。取值：

1：修复中
2：修复成功
3：修复失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the results start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20, which indicates that up to 20 entries are returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页中显示的修复任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条修复任务
parameters.name: page_size

BuildTasks.description_en: The details of the image repair tasks
BuildTasks.description_zh: 镜像修复任务的详细信息

BuildTaskId.description_en: The ID of the image repair task

FinishTime.description_en: The timestamp when the repair task started. Unit: milliseconds
FinishTime.description_zh: 修复任务开始的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FixTime.description_en: The timestamp when the repair task ended. Unit: milliseconds
FixTime.description_zh: 修复任务结束的时间戳，单位为毫秒

NewTag.description_en: The tag of the repaired image

NewUuid.description_en: The UUID of the repaired image

OldTag.description_en: The tag of the original image

OldUuid.description_en: The UUID of the original image

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the image

RepoName.description_en: The name of the image repository

Status.description_en:
The status of the image repair task. Valid values:

1: Repairing
2: Repaired
3: Repair failed
Status.description_zh:
镜像修复任务的状态。取值：

1：修复中
2：修复成功
3：修复失败

TaskType.description_en: The type of the image repair task. The value is fixed as IMAGE_REPAIR, which indicates image repair
TaskType.description_zh: 镜像修复任务的类型。此处为固定值：IMAGE_REPAIR，表示镜像修复

VulAlias.description_en: The name of the vulnerability that was repaired

Count.description_en: The number of image repair tasks on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的镜像修复任务的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the results returned. Default value: 1, which indicates that the results start from page 1
CurrentPage.description_zh: 从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: 20, which indicates that up to 20 entries are returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页中显示的修复任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条修复任务

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of image repair tasks
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的镜像修复任务的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
